newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: TNT Express forms partnership with NZ Couriers.
newsitem.headline: TNT Express forms partnership with NZ Couriers.

text.p: Distribution company TNT Express Worldwide said on Thursday it had formed a strategic partnership with New Zealand Couriers.

"The partnership leverages the undisputed strengths of both companies. TNT Express Worldwide offers market leadership into and from the prestigious Australasian, Asian and European markets, while New Zealand Couriers is this country's leading domestic courier operator," TNT said.
TNT said it had nearly 650 depots worldwide, in over 200 countries. The partnership with NZ Couriers expanded TNT's national network to over 360 towns and cities nationwide.
TNT Express Worldwide is wholly owned by Dutch postal and telecommunications corporation KPN.
